findings.claim: Open item 1 now says the value-free reuse and leak scans were rerun on the integrated tree, including the re-authored relational-design pages, and that 'their results are recorded under Protected values'. The Protected values section does not record that rerun. It still says that run 20261109T232006 checked the 30 items on teaching base 34b23353 and was repeated after the critic corrections. Its reuse result ('highest 7-gram overlap with any SQL & JDBC learner file is 0.07') names no run, commit or tree that includes the five relational-design pages re-authored by 2513e634, which changed about 2,900 lines of learner HTML. Items 01-05 have those pages as their primary topics and differsFrom targets. So the record asserts a verification on changed learner bytes that it does not actually record, against the contract rule that an unverified claim must not be badged as verified.
findings.recommendation: In Protected values, add the integrated-tree rerun as its own value-free line: the run id, the tree or commit it ran on (the merge 9cc9b4bb or later, including the re-authored relational-design pages), and its reuse and leak outcome, for example 'highest 7-gram overlap 0.0x; no leak hits'. If the rerun did not happen, run it, or reword Open item 1 so it does not claim a recorded result.
